candidates.review_note: Represent each contiguous column interval by its connectivity partition of four boundary cities (15 set partitions). Precompute all merges for two partitions and the two boundary road bits. Store the outgoing road bits at the rightmost leaf, so either vertical or horizontal changes are one segment-tree point update. An Ask combines the interval between the two columns and the possible cross-row detours in the entire prefix and suffix; ignoring these exterior detours would be wrong. A prefix or suffix attaches at exactly two boundary cities, so its sole effect is to join those two when connected. Precompute the four-endpoint query connectivity with these optional exterior joins. O(log C) update/query and O(C) memory.
